sens_en: to imitate, to copy, to resemble
origine_fr: La personne 亻 et 方, qui donne le son : se ressembler. 方 se lit fāng et donne toujours le son de fǎng. De ressembler à quelqu'un, on est passé à l'imiter.
origine_en: A person 亻 and 方, which gives the sound: to look alike. 方 is read fāng and still gives the sound fǎng. From resembling someone it moved to imitating them.

phrase.fr: Les enfants aiment imiter les grands.
